text:
Lina M: Need final sign-off on ApolloCloud micro-tile assets + marketplace strings. Partner uploaded a zip: https://files.redwood.com/apollo/badges_v2.zip. Target publish: Wed AM.
Carmen (design): Quick review: horizontal lockup loses the A tail at 140px. Recommend compact mark centered with 8px clearspace. Export checklist: SVG compact, PNG 140x140 @1x, PNG 280x280 @2x, PNG hero preview 600x300. CTA on dark needs color #002e8c to meet AA.
Priya S: Marketplace constraints: title <= 60 chars, description <= 140 chars, alt text <= 125 chars. Also need a 1-line tagline and a slightly longer case blurb for the study page.
Alex Chen (Apollo): Confirmed byline: "Alex Chen, VP Cloud Infrastructure". Partner ok to use quote: "Cut inference costs by 3x in prod." and logo assets.
LegalBot: Received signed asset use agreement (AG-AP-2026). No extra restrictions; attribution required.
MarketplaceOps: Provide proposed strings here and we'll validate length and encoding for FR/DE locales. Also we'll run accessibility checks on CTA contrast once assets posted.
Carmen (design): Proposed strings:
short_title: ApolloCloud  Managed GPU inference (45 chars)
short_desc: Production-grade inference with 3x cost reduction for large language models (98 chars)
case_blurb: ApolloCloud and Redwood Inference teamed to deploy production LLMs with reduced latency and threefold cost savings via batching and KV caching (154 chars)
alt_text: ApolloCloud compact mark  managed GPU inference for production LLMs (90 chars)
(Notes: will replace placeholders; planning to center compact mark for micro-tile.)
Priya S: Short_desc OK but remove trailing punctuation. For case_blurb change numeric style to words (threefold) — Alex ok with that for case page. Short marketplace can keep "3x".
Alex Chen (Apollo): Fine with those edits. I'll send localized FR/DE strings by EOD tomorrow.
Carmen (design): Uploading exports now to the same folder and adding export spec doc. Link: https://files.redwood.com/apollo/exports_v2.
Lina M: Final checklist: 1) Carmen confirms uploads; 2) Priya publishes marketplace strings after localization; 3) LegalBot shows signed consent (done); 4) MarketplaceOps schedules publish Wed AM and runs AA checks. Ping here when uploads complete. :white_check_mark:
